subject.title: fix(discord): prevent original replies flashing before outbound hooks

question: Should Discord intentionally disable provider previews whenever a globally registered outbound hook can rewrite or cancel replies, accepting reduced streaming feedback for those deployments to prevent pre-hook content exposure?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and has strong behavior proof, but it establishes a user-visible safety policy for all existing Discord installations using these global hooks while the canonical issue still records broader hook-pipeline behavior.

options.title: Accept safety-first preview suppression
options.body: Merge the Discord-local gate so rewritable or cancellable replies cannot flash before outbound hooks, while retaining the canonical issue for the remaining delivery paths.

options.title: Require a broader hook-ordering design first
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose and validate one consistent hook ordering across preview and non-preview channel delivery paths.

recommendation.title: Accept safety-first preview suppression
recommendation.body: Merge the Discord-local gate so rewritable or cancellable replies cannot flash before outbound hooks, while retaining the canonical issue for the remaining delivery paths.
